DHCPv4::reject
       This command drops the packet while sending ICMP packet about the drop reason.

SYNOPSIS
       DHCPv4::reject

DESCRIPTION
       This command drops the packet while sending ICMP packet about the drop reason

       Details (syntax): DHCPv4::reject

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_DATA {
	    DHCPv4::reject
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0
	    --First introduced the command.
